description: This file defines the CommandClient interface for the Hono client API, providing methods to send commands (both request-response and one-way) to devices within the platform. It specifies various overloaded methods for sending commands with optional content types, properties, and data buffers.

classes.name: CommandClient
classes.description: Interface for a client to interact with Hono's Command and Control API, allowing sending of commands to devices with different configurations.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to a device expecting a response, with optional content type, data, and properties.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommand
methods.description: Sends a one-way command to a device where no response is expected, with optional content type, data, and properties.
